fields.description: Checks for explicit imagePullPolicy: Always on every applicable container. Immutable images with pull-on-miss are assessed by a separate check.

fields.summary: Set the applicable containers’ imagePullPolicy to Always.
steps: Set imagePullPolicy to Always after verifying registry access.
caveats: A SHA256 digest with IfNotPresent does not satisfy this literal policy; the separate immutable-image check accepts that configuration. Image trust and runtime pulls were not tested.

fields.description: Checks regular containers for nonzero hostPort declarations. Zero is the documented default and publishes no host port.
fields.pass_when: No regular container declares a nonzero hostPort.
fields.fail_when: A regular container declares a hostPort from 1 through 65535.

steps: Remove unnecessary nonzero hostPort declarations and use the intended Service instead.
caveats: Explicit hostPort 0 publishes no host port. This regular-container declaration check does not prove reachability or cover every other exposure path.

fields.description: Checks the declared seccomp profile for regular, init and ephemeral containers. A container profile overrides the Pod default.
fields.pass_when: Every assessed container inherits or declares RuntimeDefault.
fields.fail_when: An assessed container does not inherit or declare RuntimeDefault.

steps: Declare RuntimeDefault at Pod level or on each assessed container.
Remove conflicting init, ephemeral or regular-container overrides after checking compatibility.
caveats: An explicit container profile overrides the Pod default. Running kernel enforcement and kubelet runtime defaults were not inspected.

fields.description: Resolves declared rule and default-backend Services in the same namespace, then checks the nginx HTTPS/GRPCS annotation. No TLS handshake is performed.

caveats: The declared nginx protocol and every rule/default backend Service must resolve. This does not prove backend TLS availability, certificate validity or controller enforcement.

fields.description: Checks whether the namespace declares an all-Pod default-deny ingress NetworkPolicy. Empty label-selector fields have the same all-Pod meaning as an empty selector.

caveats: A default-deny declaration does not establish the effective result of additive policies or network-plugin enforcement. Empty matchLabels and matchExpressions still select all Pods.

fields.description: Checks whether the namespace declares an all-Pod default-deny egress NetworkPolicy. Empty label-selector fields have the same all-Pod meaning as an empty selector.

caveats: A default-deny declaration does not establish the effective result of additive policies or network-plugin enforcement. Empty matchLabels and matchExpressions still select all Pods.
